title_en: Notice on the Calculation Standard for Compensation for Infringement of Citizens' Personal Freedom in State Compensation Decisions Made in 2025
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Calculation Standard for Compensation for Infringement of Citizens' Personal Freedom in National Compensation Decisions Made in 2025

Fa [2025] No. 75

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

According to the data published by the National Bureau of Statistics on May 16, 2025, the average annual wage of employees in urban non-private sector units nationwide in 2024 was 124,110 yuan. Based on the formula for calculating the average daily wage provided by the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the average daily wage is 475.52 yuan. In accordance with Article 33 of the State Compensation Law and Article 21(2) of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Compensation Cases, when people's courts at all levels make national compensation decisions from May 19, 2025, the compensation for infringement of citizens' personal freedom shall be calculated at 475.52 yuan per day.

This notice is hereby given, and it shall be complied with accordingly.

May 19, 2025
